University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Panjab University, Sector-25, Chandigarh 160014
Project Staff Requirement
Applications are invited for the appointment of Project Associate-II -01 in DST funded project
entitled “Science Technology and Innovation Hub in Tele-Healthcare for Preventive Health”
for a period of 1 year OR coterminous with project depending upon the satisfactory performance of
the candidate at University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET), Sector-25, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.

 2 years' experience in relevant areas
Rs.

HRA
Responsibilities:
 Implementation and monitoring of project activities across designated sites, ensuring alignment
with project objectives and timelines.
 Coordinate with state health departments, and field teams for smooth execution of healthcare
interventions.
 Spearheading data collection and concomitant interpretation.
 Support deployment of digital health solutions including troubleshooting and user training.
 Documentation tracking and record maintenance.
 Inspecting authoritative publications to discern understudied topics.
 Crafting and proposing project ideas.
 Conducting in-house/ outside presentations.
 Focused working and high quality outcome is expected from the selected candidates.
 Project may involve frequent field travel to different states of India for project implementation.
 Any other work assigned by PI/Co-PIs
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for any
project exigency. Date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible/ shortlisted
candidates through email or phone. No separate call letters will be issued for the interview. No
TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.
Candidates can apply within 7-days from date of advertisement through Google form Link
https://forms.gle/ixrboeiPbRD4p7zE8
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
